serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: KUDO for Government (KFG)​ provides a secured online meeting platform with real-time language interpretation capabilities to the US government agencies and supporting organizations. Participants can watch, speak and hear the live interpretation of their choice. KUDO builds a marketplace of more than 13,000 professional interpreters globally and provides a centralized way for agencies to secure web and third-party applications across their global infrastructure throughout the system lifecycle without slowing innovation.
